title: LoonBow Plushie's
description: LoonBow Plushies is a vanilla-friendly resource pack created by the Cubic Team that adds collectible plushies to your world. To get a plushie, simply rename a piece of paper in an anvil to the corresponding plushie name.
body: LoonBow Plushies is a vanilla-friendly resource pack by the Cubic Team that brings cute and collectible LoonBow plushies into Minecraft. Designed to fit seamlessly within the game's default style, the pack allows players to decorate their worlds with unique plushie variants. To get a plushie, simply place a piece of paper in an anvil and rename it to "LoonBow Plushie" or "Gray LoonBow Plushie". Once renamed, the paper will become a decorative plushie item perfect for display in your builds, homes, and collection areas.
